description: Defines the ThemeVariables class in the OrangeHRM Corporate Branding plugin, representing theme color and font color variables with methods for construction and access.

classes.name: ThemeVariables
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) encapsulating theme color and font color variables for corporate branding in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes ThemeVariables with specified color and font color values.

methods.name: getPrimaryGradientStartColor
methods.description: Returns the primary gradient start color.

methods.name: getPrimaryGradientEndColor
methods.description: Returns the primary gradient end color.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates a ThemeVariables instance from an associative array of color values.
